nominations.basis: Probed 2026-09-18 with scripts/probe_candidate_pages.py: the page reads 2,348 readable characters (above the verifier's 400-char floor) and the verifier's own label test matches this node as "National Security Council | The White House" in region content, not navigation. This is NARA's archived copy of the previous administration's whitehouse.gov NSC section, and the basis says so deliberately: the CURRENT www.whitehouse.gov has no NSC page at all (/nsc/ and /administration/executive-office-of-the-president/national-security-council/ are both HTTP 404, and the live EOP page's own body lists only OMB, OSTP, CEA, ONCD, ONDCP and CEQ), so an archived .gov page is the only page this project can read that labels the unit. It supports exactly one claim -- a .gov page names the National Security Council as a heading -- and nothing about the council's current structure.

Second probed page for the same unit, 2026-09-18: 3,061 readable characters and the verifier's label test matches "National Security Council – The White House" in region content. Offered as a fallback if the first archived host fails on the verifier's own fetch; same archived-site caveat as above.
